container: Social media significantly impacts youth by shaping their self-image, communication skills, and social interactions. While it offers opportunities for connection, self-expression, and learning, excessive use can lead to anxiety, depression, and reduced attention spans. Cyberbullying and exposure to unrealistic lifestyles contribute to low self-esteem. However, when used mindfully, social media can foster creativity, activism, and global awareness. Parents and educators play a crucial role in guiding responsible usage to ensure a healthy balance between online and real-life experiences.
